title: Android 1.0.9 verified and copied to phone
summary: Build 11 with Tailscale address support is available in the connected phone?s Zakaria folder; its checksum matches the verified APK.

changes.detail: Created signed release APK 1.0.9 (11), 146940678 bytes, and copied it to /sdcard/Zakaria/lecomax-learn-1.0.9-build11.apk.

Release packages current app source including Tailscale address support and the 108-report history snapshot containing release preparation. Later interaction and delivery reports are preserved in source for a future build.

validation.name: Source checks
validation.detail: TypeScript, focused ESLint and 18 focused tests passed across release, history, API origin, PC URL policy, PC interaction and bridge security. An outdated HTTPS-rejection interaction assertion initially failed; corrected and rerun successfully, recorded in pc-tailscale-interaction-verified-20261011.

validation.name: Android build
validation.detail: Gradle assembleRelease succeeded in 14m54s with dependency deprecation warnings.

validation.name: APK identity and signature
validation.detail: Package com.lecomax.learning, version 1.0.9 / 11, ARM64 support, production update channel, backup disabled and embedded release report verified. Signing certificate matches build 10.

validation.name: APK secret audit
validation.detail: All 1360 ZIP entries scanned for known private values and credential patterns. Original generic PEM filename rule flagged public Python and Expo certificates; scoped audit allows only those two paths, requires certificate content and still scans both for private keys. This does not prove absence of unknown or encoded secrets.

validation.detail: APK copied only; installed app remains build 10. No physical Tailscale 4G/5G acceptance test or public deployment.
